purpose: Explicit scalar and immediate action-request storage contracts; source changes revoke evidence until reviewed again. Deferred handlers remain separate.
evidence: Source bodies and scalar-push/set helpers reviewed alongside original Ghidra80115228/8011601C/8011604C and bounded original-instruction cases. Read-only helper chains reviewed separately; lookup predecessor writes target a C-stack temporary. Actor/object prefix definitions and vmAddress offset checks bind the shared context lookup; handle-domain branches checked against original Ghidra8011DD38/8011DD78/8011DDB8/80118ACC and twenty-four guarded replacement cases. Coordinate, packed-counter and actor creation-argument helper paths reviewed against original Ghidra80117480/801174B0/80114CC8/8012056C and thirty-five authored original-instruction cases. Twelve action-request wrappers and their two-field scheduling helper reviewed against original Ghidra801167A0 and all twelve original wrapper addresses; twenty-four direct original-instruction request cases guard all VM fields and pending/protected values. Selector-three deferred dispatch and helper chain reviewed against original Ghidra80117098/8000F4C4/801167BC/800120F0 and eight guarded direct-dispatch/scheduler cases.
